description: Analyzes the mode-selective projection of the Habiro trace onto Toroidal Harmonics. Confirms that the order-gap in the continuum limit corresponds to isolating a specific toroidal mode (e.g. m=1/2 or m=1) from the discrete multi-mode knot trace.

data.ODE_mapping: Toroidal Harmonic ODE maps to Weber ODE locally near turning points via Liouville-Green transformation.
data.Mode_Selection: The exact discrete Habiro trace contains multiple modes. The f-map projects away all but the principal Toroidal Harmonic, eliminating the lower-order O(sqrt(u)) gap.
